answer: A bond of 33% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in walnut, and orchard reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 85 aliases, and each one needs its own funded nectar account. Each duplicate costs another 115 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
